calcBodyFatHint: Idan kun san shi — daga maʼauni mai wayo, kaliba ko binciken DEXA — sai a gina ƙiyasin bisa nauyin jikinku ba tare da kitse ba maimakon jimlar nauyinku, wanda ya fi kusa da gaskiya ga jiki mai siriri ko mai tsoka. Idan ba ku sani ba, ku bar shi fanko: hasashe a nan yana lalata sakamako, ba gyara shi ba.
calcCheckStep1: Ku riƙe burin har mako biyu ko uku. Ƙasa da haka ba auna ba ne: ruwa, gishiri da zagayowar alʼada suna motsa maʼauni kilo ɗaya kowane bangare, kuma babu abin da ake gani ta cikin wannan hayaniya.
calcCheckStep2: Ku auna kanku kowace safiya iri ɗaya — bayan bayan gida, kafin ci. Ku kwatanta matsakaicin mako, ba ranaku ɗaiɗaiku ba.
calcCheckStep3: Matsakaicin bai motsa ba alhali kuna son ya sauka? Ku duba littafin da farko, ba yadda jiki ke ƙona abinci ba: mutane suna rage bayanin abin da suka ci da kashi 20–40%, kuma yawanci mai ne a tukunya da cizon da aka ɗauka a tsaye. Sannan ku cire kcal 100–200 ku duba wasu mako biyu.
calcCheckStep4: Kuna saukowa fiye da 1% na nauyinku a mako? Ku mayar da kcal 100–200: wannan gudun yana cin tsoka.
calcCheckStep5: Duk bayan kilo biyar, ku dawo ku sake lissafawa. Jiki mai sauƙi yana kashe ƙasa — lambar da ta yi aiki a Maris ta daina aiki a Mayu.
calcEstimateBody: Maʼaunin bai san ku ba. Yana ba da matsakaicin mutanen da suke da tsayinku, nauyinku, shekarunku da jinsinku — kuma mafi kyawunsu yana sauka cikin 10% ga mutum huɗu daga cikin biyar. A kcal 2400 wannan 10% shi ne kcal 240: duk bambanci tsakanin raguwa da tsayawa a wuri ɗaya. Shi ya sa lambar da ke ƙasa ita ce inda za ku fara auna, ba amsar ba.
calcEstimateTitle: Wurin farawa ne, ba maʼaunin ku ba
calcFiberNote: Fiba ita ce mafi girma daga cikin ƙaʼidodi biyu: 14 g ga kowace kcal 1000, da 1 g ga kowane 5 g na furotin — amma ba ƙasa da 25 g ba. A cin abinci mai furotin mai yawa ƙaʼidar kalori kaɗai ba ta isa ba, kuma fiba ce ta farko da take tafiya: furotin yana tura karbohaidret waje, kuma duk fiba a cikinsu take.
calcFormulaKatch: An lissafa da maʼaunin Katch–McArdle, daga nauyin jikinku ba tare da kitse ba — wannan ita ce hanya mafi daidai.
calcFormulaMifflin: An lissafa da maʼaunin Mifflin–St Jeor, daga nauyinku.
calcNoteAgeOutside: An gwada maʼaunin a kan manya masu shekara 19 zuwa 78 — a wajen wannan iyakar ƙiyasi ne mai kauri.
calcNoteClampedBmr: Gibin ya kai ga kashewar jikinku a lokacin hutu ya tsaya a nan — ƙasa da haka ba rage cin abinci ba ne kuma.
calcNoteClampedFloor: An ɗaga shi zuwa iyakar ƙasa: kcal 1200 ga mata, 1500 ga maza.
calcNoteMinor: Ƙasa da shekara goma sha takwas, jikin da yake girma aikin likita ne, ba na naʼurar lissafi ba.
calcNoteNoDeficit: Bisa wannan ƙiyasin babu inda za a yanke: iyakar ƙasa ta riga ta wuce abin da kuke kashewa. Wannan magana ce ta likita, ba ta manhaja ba.
calcNoteRateTooFast: Ya fi 1% na nauyinku a mako: a wannan gudun tsoka na tafiya tare da kitse.
calcNoteUnderweight: Nauyinku ya riga ya kasance ƙasa da lafiyayyen iyaka na tsayinku.
calcRateCapped: Ƙiyasin ba zai wuce wannan gudun ba: ƙasa da haka burin zai sauka ƙasa da abin da jikinku ke kashewa a hutu.
calcRateSafe: Gudun da za a iya ci gaba da shi shi ne 0.5–1% na nauyin jiki a mako.

licenseUsdaBody:
Sinadaran abinci da maʼaunan gida sun fito daga USDA FoodData Central (FoodData Central, U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service).

Bayanan mallakar jamaʼa ne: ayyukan hukumomin tarayya na Amurka ba sa ƙarƙashin haƙƙin mallaka (17 U.S.C. §105).

Maʼaikatar Noma ta Amurka ba ta da alaƙa da wannan manhajar kuma ba ta amince da ita ba.

syncIntroKitchen: Eluna tana ajiye kome a wannan naʼurar. Daidaitawa tana ƙara kwafi mai ɓoye a cloud da tuni yake naku: wayar da ta ɓace ba za ta ƙwace muku shekarar cin abinci ba, kuma naʼurori biyu suna tafiya tare.
syncNoCloudHere: Babu cloud a wannan naʼurar: ku shiga iCloud, ko ku ajiye bayananku cikin fayil — yana nan ƙasa.
